bio: Mario Ridder has chosen a historical building brimming with character in the heart of Delft in which to celebrate wine and French cuisine. Divided into a bar, wine bar and brasserie, Lalou is the epitome of nostalgic charm – think leather ceiling, Renaissance paintings and chandeliers. The exclusive wine list exceeds 700 labels, reflecting the chef's passion for the grape. The appealing menu includes many dishes that can be ordered as half portions. An indulgent salad niçoise, lobster ravioli with a frothy bisque, delicately sweet crêpe suzette: expect no unnecessary embellishments, just fantastic ingredients and generous brasserie flavours....
